{"invites":[{"spec_id":"spec_0536","text":"Budget Review (Again) - Fjord Migration Spend - Since the Spreadsheet Apparently Wasn't Clear Enough - Mei walking through the same numbers already shared on the drive, for the benefit of those who didn't open the link - Ilse, Ximena, Maeve, Tariq, Noor, Gus + Finance + Curatorial leads - Please read the variance tab beforehand, or don't, it's all been in the shared folder since the 3rd - Lakepoint Museum of Art, Board Room B - 60 min, 2:00-3:00 PM - No decisions expected, just making sure everyone has actually seen the figures this time"},{"spec_id":"spec_0537","text":"Hi all, per the standing process outlined in the Q2 production governance doc, I am proposing we reinstate the weekly Kestrel 2.0 status sync. Recipients: @Valentina Rinaldi @Fatima Gallo @Leon Iversen. Proposed slot is Thursdays 10:00-10:30, recurring, in the Glenworks Interactive Ops room or the usual Teams bridge. Format would follow the standard template: each attendee provides a round-robin update on their workstream, followed by any items requiring cross-team alignment. Please submit your update bullets to the tracker no later than Wednesday EOD so they can be compiled into the pre-read. Kindly confirm attendance via thread reply so I can log it for the compliance record. If the slot conflicts, please raise it through the scheduling channel rather than DM. Thanks, Joaquin"},{"spec_id":"spec_0538","text":"---------- Forwarded message ----------

Yara"},{"spec_id":"spec_0540","text":"Title: Jaramillo Contract - Vendor Demo (attendance please)
Date/Time: Thursday, 3:30 PM - 4:00 PM
Location: District Office, Conference Room A / also Zoom for who is remote
Description:
Dear colleagues,
As some of you were asking to "see it working" before we sign, the vendor will do the demonstration of the platform now. Invited: Rosa Uchenna, Marcus Iversen, Maeve Szabo, Ximena Mbatha, Sam Ferraro, Carmen Petrakis, and the principals representatives.
Please to bring your questions with you, because the vendor will not answer by email after, and also we have to give the answer to the Granitewood Public Schools board next week. It would be nice if this time the people who have concerns come to say them in the room and not after.
Thank you,
Farid"}]}
